question: residential buildings total area hectares
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 10000 AS area_ha FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'residential';

question: footway total length km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway';

question: largest building footprint
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: residential roads total length
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential';

question: total road network length km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads;

question: longest road segment
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads ORDER BY ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 1;
